dedupe_keys.name: overstory vegetation intelligence for utility vegetation management and wildfire risk commercial

description: Overstory is a commercial service that gives electric utilities vegetation intelligence for vegetation management, which the company calls many utilities' greatest operations and maintenance expense. It creates vegetation data by combining AI with remote sensing from satellite and aerial imagery, then joins it with local information such as asset locations, wildfire maps and terrain. Uses listed on the solutions page are trim cycle optimisation at span and circuit level, work quantification for bid packages, targeted identification of strike trees, declining trees and hazard trees, reporting and auditing of risk change between scans, overlaying encroachment risk, hazard trees and species on wildfire risk maps, high-reliability zones from substations to the first protective device, compliance and transmission work type classification, contractor audit, and spotting trees likely to cause outages before extreme weather. The page quotes customer results for distribution and transmission utilities in the US. Access is a paid service available online after contacting the company for a demo; pricing and licence terms are not published. Coverage is wherever imagery and customer asset data exist. Caveats: proprietary models and outputs, with performance figures reported by the vendor. Simulation uses are span-level vegetation strike and wildfire ignition exposure for distribution and transmission outage and resilience models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
